description: Archive completed plans. Moves finished folder plans from .unikit/code/plans/<folder>/ to .unikit/code/archive/plans/<folder>/, so plan lookup and the plan lists stop offering them; an unfinished plan moves only when the user picks it, and is marked as unfinished. Lists every plan with its created and last-change dates; plans can be picked by number or by date. Never deletes, renames or commits. Use when user says "archive plans", "archive completed", "archive old plans", "clean up plans", or "show archived plans". Not for .unikit/code/PLAN.md or FIX_PLAN.md; to check that a plan is really done use /unikit-verify, to commit the move use /unikit-commit.
